context: Keep `benchbox.cli.main` as the canonical lazy compatibility module and give that module a small ModuleType subclass with `__call__` forwarding to its existing lazily resolved `main` export. This preserves module identity, dotted patching, `inspect.ismodule`, and callable package imports without eagerly importing benchbox.cli.app or heavy platform dependencies.
description: Read-only review of PR #1338 confirmed that its resolver fix changes the explicitly exported package API: before the PR, `from benchbox.cli import main` returns a callable function; after it, the same import returns a non-callable module. The submodule must remain a real ModuleType so Python 3.10 dotted patch resolution reaches `benchbox.cli.main.get_config_manager`, but the historic package-level callable contract should not be silently removed.

anti_patterns.dont: eagerly import benchbox.cli.app to obtain its main function
anti_patterns.instead: resolve the existing lazy main export only when the module is called
anti_patterns.why: eager import pulls in the CLI command tree and optional platform dependencies

anti_patterns.dont: restore package-level caching of the entrypoint function under the name main
anti_patterns.instead: keep the submodule bound and make the compatibility module callable
anti_patterns.why: function caching recreates the order-dependent Python 3.10 resolver defect

preserves.behavior: benchbox.cli.main remains a real ModuleType for Python 3.10 dotted target resolution
from benchbox.cli import main remains callable
importing benchbox.cli or benchbox.cli.main does not import polars or datafusion
the benchbox console entrypoint remains benchbox.cli.app:main

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "from benchbox.cli import main; import types; assert isinstance(main, types.ModuleType) and callable(main)"
verifications.description: Package import is simultaneously callable and a module

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "import benchbox.cli; _ = benchbox.cli.main; from unittest.mock import patch; p=patch('benchbox.cli.main.get_config_manager'); p.start(); p.stop()"
verifications.description: Python 3.10-style dotted patch target still resolves

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "import sys; from benchbox.cli import main; assert callable(main); assert 'polars' not in sys.modules and 'datafusion' not in sys.modules"

verifications.description: Focused lazy CLI contract tests pass

work_units.evidence: Implemented _CallableMainModule in benchbox/cli/main.py; Python 3.10.17 shim proof confirms ModuleType identity, callable behavior, and dotted patch resolution.
work_units.summary: Make the historic main compatibility module callable while preserving ModuleType identity

work_units.evidence: Added fresh-interpreter callable assertion and call-delegation regression plus lazy-module callable coverage; focused suite passes 10 tests.
work_units.summary: Add fresh-interpreter regressions for callable import, dotted patching, and lazy dependencies
